title: Philadelphia Experiment sailors stuck in walls

tellings.quote: And that's temporal displacement. The rumors that the people were some people were stuck between a wall or like physical physical matter and space.

plain: There is a rumor that some of the people caught up in the Philadelphia Experiment, a secret experiment said to have taken place in Philadelphia in 1943, ended up stuck inside walls, their bodies merged with solid matter. Dave Rossi, a guest who says aliens taught him advanced physics, repeats this rumor as something he has heard. He explains it as "temporal displacement", meaning people shifted out of place in time and space, which would mean the experiment did far more than anyone has admitted.
